mcqs.question: What unprecedented feature was announced for US currency in March 2026?
options: The signature of a sitting President on US currency
A 24-carat gold coin bearing the President’s image
The continuation of Treasury signatures introduced in 1861
A currency issue commemorating the 250th US Independence Day
mcqs.explanation: US currency was announced to carry the signature of a sitting President for the first time, with the $100 note scheduled to be issued first in June 2026. The 24-carat gold coin, the 1861 Treasury-signature practice and the 250th Independence Day are related details, but they are not the unprecedented feature asked here.
